searches.reason: Test whether easy sampled negatives conceal weak candidate discrimination. Compare uniform multi-negative training against a gradual mixture of uniform and moderately difficult title/description neighbors, using false-negative filtering and sampling-probability correction where justified. Strong training margins do not establish validation ranking quality; retain the corrected HSTU and select by host macro validation HR@10.

searches.reason: Investigate whether jointly learned relative-time and positional biases within HSTU can distinguish recent intent from stale interests. Public timestamps support this direction without inventing user traits. Compare positional-only and time-aware variants; assess context perturbations as in-sample diagnostics and use host validation for selection.
searches.query: HSTU relative temporal attention bias time-aware sequential recommendation recency long-term interest 2024 2025 2026

searches.reason: Explore a jointly trained title/description encoder inside one HSTU model to distinguish concrete compatibility and task intent from broad lexical similarity. Learn text features from supplied metadata without pretrained weights, and compare against ID-only and lexical-negative controls. Treat missing compatibility information as unknown, and retain one checkpoint per category.
